📺 Drop Dead Diva (2009–2014)

Drop Dead Diva follows Deb Dobkins, a beautiful and aspiring model whose life comes to an unexpected end after a fatal car accident. When she attempts to return to Earth, her soul accidentally enters the body of Jane Bingum, a brilliant and hardworking attorney who has just been shot. Forced to adjust to an entirely different life, Deb must navigate the demanding world of law while discovering Jane’s intelligence, professional abilities, and compassionate personality. Things become even more complicated when she learns that her former boyfriend, Grayson, works at the same law firm, unaware of her true identity. With the support of her best friend Stacy and a guardian angel, she tackles challenging legal cases while learning valuable lessons about inner beauty and self-worth. Starring Brooke Elliott, Margaret Cho, April Bowlby, and Jackson Hurst, the series combines hilarious comedy, heartfelt romance, and engaging courtroom drama while exploring identity, acceptance, friendship, love, and second chances.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Fantasy • Legal Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Josh Berman

📺 Seasons: 6 • 78 Episodes

📍 Setting: Los Angeles, California.

source_details.synopsis: Drop Dead Diva is an American legal comedy-drama/fantasy television series that aired on Lifetime from July 12, 2009, to June 22, 2014. The series was created by Josh Berman and produced by Sony Pictures Television. It stars Brooke Elliott as Jane, a plus-sized lawyer whose body is inhabited by the soul of a fashion model. In January 2013, Lifetime canceled the series after its fourth season. That March, the network reversed its decision, renewing the series for a fifth season that premiered in June 2013. In October 2013, Lifetime renewed the series for a sixth and final season.
